protocol.scope: _with_source_inputs(work) lazily loads existing AST and MethodExpr collectors and nests their invocation-local scopes under the actual current SourceOrigins token. Work context is preserved. Loading preserves caller error; existing capture wrappers keep their already verified successful caller-error semantics and fatal/alias/once-only scalar behavior.
protocol.root: _event_input_for(actual_event) grants only its currently selected actual SourceOrigins frame. Opaque blessed scalar grant is lookup identity; detached _input_description is metadata.
protocol.capture: _capture_ast_input(parent_grant, callback, source, ...), _capture_method_input and _capture_csv_input always execute their actual callback once through the existing collectors, preserving original argument aliases and actual returned values. Retain actual outer/native captures, callback, initial source and actual parent grant only in the current scope. AST registration requires an eligible actual native root, preserving the native collector's immediate release of opaque results. Actual before RED1 and after GREEN use the same paired weak-reference oracle; initial draft proof stays retained and unadmitted.
protocol.getters: _ast_input_for(actual_capture, actual_callback, actual_event, actual_node) and _argument_input_for(actual_capture, actual_callback, actual_event, actual_arguments, index) validate the actual registered capture/value/event identities and delegate current native construction/argument validation. Rebase native source-relative spans only through the validated retained parent input frame, never public base_start/search or equal-text occurrence queues.
protocol.reuse: Every grant use revalidates its original event, token, parent chain and actual current native data; changing capture values, AST ancestors, MethodExpr root/shape/indexed values, copied/foreign/nested/expired objects decline. A changed MethodExpr neighbor does not revoke an unchanged indexed grant unless the shape/root changes.
protocol.output: _append_input(builder, text, grant) copies only matching actual builder/event and validated unchanged raw input; transformed or invalid grants append generated text. _consume_input(builder, grant) consumes only its independently valid original child interval. Existing explicit source append/consume and builder APIs stay unchanged.
